executable_help:
Serve a local package or download a prepared package from Hugging Face

Usage: flare-release run [OPTIONS] <PACKAGE>

Arguments:
  <PACKAGE>  Local prepared .safetensors package or Hugging Face ORG/NAME[@REVISION]

Options:
      --publisher-keys <PATH>
          Additional publisher verification profiles (JSON); does not grant execution trust. Development packages default to ~/.config/flare/development-publisher.json
      --verify-weights
          Verify stored allocation and table ranges before loading model GPU resources
      --dangerously-approve-key <FINGERPRINT>
          Permanently accept this exact signing key together with --dangerously-accept-publisher
      --dangerously-accept-publisher <NAMESPACE>
          Exact Hugging Face publisher namespace acknowledged for unattended first use
      --trust-store <PATH>
          Persistent trust file [default: ~/.config/flare/trust.toml]
  -h, --help
          Print help

Serving options:
      --host <ADDR>
          IP address for the HTTP server [default: 127.0.0.1]
      --port <N>
          Port for the HTTP server [default: 8000]
      --served-model-name <ALIAS>
          Replace the package's serving alias; the canonical model ID remains accepted
      --api-key-file <PATH>
          File containing the serving API key; omit to disable authentication
      --scheduler-policy <MODE>
          Favor token throughput, balance it with output cadence, or value agents' prompts closer to output; all retain token-service fairness [default: balanced] [possible values: balanced, throughput, agent]
      --unclamped-sampling
          Validation only: accept request sampling values outside the package's model-author ranges, e.g. top_k 1 for greedy token-for-token comparisons. Not for serving
      --gpus <N[,N...]>
          GPUs in rank order, relative to CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES when set [default: 0]
      --kv-cache-limit <MODE>
          Limit KV capacity by available memory, one context, or context times concurrency [default: memory] [possible values: concurrency, context, memory]
      --memory-limit <LIMIT>
          Per-GPU serving memory: occupied size (30G), free reserve (-30G), or total fraction (0.8). Omitted: package serving reserve
      --max-concurrency <N>
          Maximum simultaneous requests [default: package setting]
      --embedding-table-storage <MODE>
          Storage for auxiliary embedding tables (PLE/Engram) [default: disk] [possible values: disk, ram]
      --embedding-table-cache-size <SIZE>
          Per-host budget for a disk-backed embedding row cache, e.g. 1G; includes the index, usage counters and miss workspace. Selects disk storage; 0 disables [default: 0] [default: 0]
      --embedding-table-resident-scales
          Retain embedding scales in host RAM while weights remain on disk; adds to the row-cache budget

Multi-host options:
      --roce-ring               Experimental ring in rank order: only neighbor RoCE QPs connect; native CPU relays forward non-neighbor traffic. Also emulates a ring on a switch
      --rendezvous <HOST:PORT>  Rank zero's rendezvous address: where rank zero listens, or on a peer, where it joins rank zero
      --rank <N>                This host's rank of a multi-host package

Speculation options:
      --mtp-pipeline                  Queue the next speculative round behind the running one so graph submission overlaps execution; one local rank, device MTP proposals, no grammar or custom stops
      --mtp-draft-tokens <N>          Maximum drafts per round; 0 disables speculation [default: package setting]
      --mtp-adaptive-verification     Adapt verification width to acceptance estimates and execution cost [default: fixed width]. Adaptive rounds depend on batch composition, so sampled outputs then differ between concurrent and solo requests
      --no-mtp-adaptive-verification  Use the maximum width where captured, otherwise width one [default]

Download options:
      --revision <REVISION>  Hub revision; defaults to gb10 or gb202 detected from the selected GPUs
      --filename <FILE>      Package filename; required when the revision contains several .safetensors files
      --cache-dir <PATH>     Hugging Face hub cache [default: ~/.cache/huggingface/hub]
      --token-file <PATH>    Hugging Face access token file; omit for public repositories
      --offline              Use only cached files, without contacting Hugging Face

Advanced serving options:
      --embedding-table-workers <N>  Disk workers per embedding table; shares a fixed I/O budget [default: 4 on Windows, 1 elsewhere] [possible values: 1, 2, 4, 8]

Advanced speculation options:
      --mtp-verification-token-budget <N>
          Advanced: fix the total verification-row budget, including pending inputs, using one exact captured packed graph per batch [default: adaptive within captured capacities]. Requires adaptive prefix selection at the captured draft depth
      --mtp-max-verification-token-budget <N>
          Advanced: retain all captured packed verification capacities up to N total rows, including pending inputs [default: all captured capacities]. Requires adaptive prefix selection at the captured draft depth

Prefix cache options:
      --prefix-cache-memory <SIZE>
          Host memory for prefix checkpoints and prepared inputs, e.g. 16G; 0 disables [default: disabled]
      --prefix-cache-disk <DIR>
          Directory for prefix checkpoints and prepared inputs on disk [default: disabled]
      --prefix-cache-disk-limit <SIZE>
          Disk retention limit, e.g. 100G; 0 disables [default: 10% of free space]
      --prefix-cache-disk-transport <MODE>
          Transfer disk checkpoints through host staging or GPUDirect Storage [default: staged] [possible values: staged, direct]

Examples:
  flare run model.safetensors --gpus 0 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
  flare run model.safetensors --embedding-table-storage ram --mtp-draft-tokens 3

Concurrency and draft limits must fit the package's prepared capacities.
Omitted concurrency and speculation options use package defaults.

capacity.note: KV pool includes shared/private backing; served per-request context comes from the native model card, not pool tokens divided by four.

metrics_delta.interval_note: Includes client execution and the real harness's solo exactness requests; no throughput is inferred from this interval.

summary.aggregate_basis: successful native output tokens / measured batch wall time, including prefill and HTTP
summary.decode_window_basis: sum of tokens after each request's first observation / earliest first to latest last observation
summary.tau_unavailable_reason: Native verify_steps counts graphs, including terminal no-ops, rather than progressing request rounds. draft_rounds excludes width-one/no-offer request rounds. generated-minus-accepted also misses budget-clipped rounds with no bonus. Use measure_mtp.measure on retained graphs for exact tau.
